reasons.text: Duplicate check found another claim sharing the same serial number (72e24bd0-df6d-5f8e-a274-b65dbd017a7c), so the claim must be sent to a person for review under the flag rule.
The label photo is legible and shows SM1977, a recalled model, so the model is confirmed.
Retailer Designbydelta.com is on the sold-at list and the purchase date 2008-12-24 falls inside the sale window; no receipt is required.
No destruction photo is required for the repair remedy.
